 Los Angeles Lakers 123 – 112 Milwaukee Bucks Live Updated a minute ago Lakers vs Bucks LIVE, Score, Player Stats and Play-by-Play in NBA (123-112)
 Follow Los Angeles Lakers vs Milwaukee Bucks live score, player stats and 2026 NBA play-by-play from Fiserv Forum with Luka Doncic, Reaves and Tyler Herro.
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated November 11, 2026, 10:34 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FINAL Last update 10:34 PM ET 10:34 PM ET 2 minutes ago Thanks!
 And I stayed here! Thank you very much for your audience in this NBA match, with all the moves and emotions here at VAVEL! Stay tuned here for the repercussions and upcoming games. Good night and see you next time!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments

 Follow VAVEL on Google 10:33 PM ET 2 minutes ago End of game
 Ousmane Dieng scored one point on two free throws, followed by three points from Gary Trent Jr., and Pete Nance also scored one point on two free throws. Ousmane Dieng then scored three points, with Kasparas Jakucionis adding two points. Bronny James scored two points on two free throws, and Jakucionis added two points on two free throws, bringing the score to 123-112 for the Lakers, who won the NBA game on Wednesday!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 10:27 PM ET 9 minutes ago 18 points lead
 Gary Trent Jr. scored three points, along with two from Pete Nance, three from Jaden Hardy, and three from Ousmane Dieng, to bring the score to 118-100 for the Lakers in the final quarter, which is heading towards a victory for the LA team!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 10:23 PM ET 13 minutes ago 23 points lead
 Ziaire Williams scored two points, along with two from Walker Kessler, two from Kel'el Ware, three from Luka Doncic, and two from two free throws by Jaime Jaquez Jr. Luka Doncic scored two points, plus one from a free throw, and another from Adou Thiero, bringing the score to 115-92!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 10:11 PM ET 25 minutes ago Still in 20
 Collin Sexton added two points on two free throws. Tyler Herro added two points on two free throws, plus two more from Collin Sexton. Kel'el Ware added two points on a layup, Jaime Jaquez Jr added two points on two free throws, followed by two from Ziaire Williams, putting the score at 104-84!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 10:03 PM ET 32 minutes ago 20 points lead
 Walker Kessler scored two points with a dunk, in another low-scoring moment, to bring the score to 98-78, with the Lakers leading the Bucks by 20 points in the final quarter of the game, with a great lead for Lakers.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 9:58 PM ET 38 minutes ago 18 points lead
 Sandro Mamukelashvili added two points, along with three points from AJ Green and two points from Kel'el Ware on two free throws, to bring the score to 96-78, where the Lakers maintain an 18-point lead.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:51 PM ET an hour ago Last Q Begins
 Ryan Rollins scored three points, followed by three from Sandro Mamukelashvili. Jaime Jaquez Jr. added two points from two free throws, along with two from Jarred Vanderbilt and two from Luka Doncic. Tyler Herro added one point from two free throws, plus two from Luka Doncic, to bring the score to 94-73 at the start of the fourth quarter!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 9:42 PM ET an hour ago Eight points lead
 Jaime Jaquez Jr. scored three points, with Ziaire Williams adding three more. Ryan Rollins also scored two points, bringing the current score to 87-70 for the Lakers, who are leading by eight points in the game!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 9:38 PM ET an hour ago 10 points lead
 Ousmane Dieng scored two points with a field goal, along with three points from Sandro Mamukelashvili, followed by two points from Ziaire Williams with a dunk, to put the score at 82-62 for the Lakers over the Bucks at that point in the game.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 9:33 PM ET an hour ago 17 points lead
 Kyle Kuzma scored two points from two free throws, with Matisse Thybulle adding three points, followed by three more in quick succession, plus two from Kel'el Ware, and two from Walker Kessler, to bring the score to 77-60!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 9:30 PM ET an hour ago 13 points lead
 Matisse Thybulle scored two points, with Brayden Burries adding two in quick succession, along with three points from Luka Doncic, bringing the current score to 69-56 for the Los Angeles Lakers over the Milwaukee Bucks.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 9:24 PM ET an hour ago Start with points
 Austin Reaves added three points, with two from Tyler Herro. Kyle Kuzma scored two points on two free throws to put the score at 64-54 in the third quarter, with the Lakers 10 points ahead at the moment.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:21 PM ET an hour ago Third quarter begins
 The players returned to the court and the ball flew into the third quarter of the game between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Milwaukee Bucks, in the NBA regular season matchup, with all the plays and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:08 PM ET an hour ago Half-time statistics
 The Lakers shot 50% from two-point range, compared to 43% for the Bucks; from three-point range, the Lakers shot 32% and the Bucks 27%; and from free throws, the Lakers shot 82% and the Bucks 86%. Among the players, Doncic leads with 19 points, while the Bucks' Tyler Herro leads with 18 points.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:08 PM ET an hour ago First-half analysis and key takeaways
 The Lakers, despite struggling a bit at the beginning and at some specific moments, managed to dominate the game in these first two quarters, controlling a lead that alternated between two and 11 points, as they finished the first two quarters!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:05 PM ET 2 hours ago Halftime
 Sandro Mamukelashvili added three points from the shot, with three from Tyler Herro, in addition to two points from Austin Reaves, with two more from Jaime Jaquez Jr, followed by two from Sandro and two from Austin Reaves, putting the score at 61 to 50 heading into the break with the Lakers ahead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 9:02 PM ET 2 hours ago Seven points lead
 Collin Sexto scored two points on a layup, with Luka Doncic adding three points in quick succession, plus two points from two free throws, and two more from Tyler Herro, bringing the score to 52-45 for the Lakers in the game!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 8:58 PM ET 2 hours ago Two points lead
 Jaime Jaquez Jr. scored two points, with another on a foul. We went through a low-scoring period in the game, where the Bucks erased the Lakers' lead with another point from two free throws by Brayden Burries, bringing the score to 45-43!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 8:50 PM ET 2 hours ago Six points lead
 Tyler Herro scored two points on two free throws, along with two from Nate Ament, plus two from Tyler Herro, followed by two from two free throws by Austin Reaves. Tyler Herro scored two points, along with two from Walker Kessler, bringing the score to 45-39.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 8:48 PM ET 2 hours ago 10 points lead
 Collin Sexton scored two points with a free throw, followed by two more with a layup, giving the Lakers a 10-point lead over the Bucks, currently leading 41-31, a position the Lakers are maintaining the lead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 8:43 PM ET 2 hours ago Start with points
 Walker Kessler scored two points early on, with Sandro Mamukelashvili adding three points in quick succession, followed by three points from Jaime Jaquez Jr. and two from Sandro, bringing the score to 37-31 for the Lakers!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:36 PM ET 2 hours ago 2nd Q Starts
 Jaime Jaquez Jr scored two points, with two more to follow. Luka Doncic added two points on two free throws, with Jaime Jaquez Jr adding two points on two free throws, to put the score at 30-28, with the Lakers beating the Bucks!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 8:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Six points lead
 Tyler Herro scored three points, with Luka Doncic adding two points, in addition to Tyler Herro's two. Jaime Jaquez Jr. scored two points, with two more from Jarred Vanderbilt, bringing the score to 28-22 for the Lakers!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 8:27 PM ET 2 hours ago Nine points lead
 Sandro Mamukelashvili scored three points on the shot, with Kyle Kuzma adding two points, along with two from Austin Reaves, three from Ryan Rollins, two from Luka Doncic, and two from Sandro, bringing the score to 24-15!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 8:23 PM ET 2 hours ago Four points lead
 Austin Reaves scored two points, with another on a foul, in addition to three from Luka Doncic. Kyle Kuzma added three points, bringing the current score to 14-10 for the Lakers over the Bucks, who are managing to maintain their lead in this early stage of the game.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 8:20 PM ET 2 hours ago Lakers leading
 Luka Doncic scored two points, with two more from Austin Reaves. Luka Doncic then added two more points with a shot, putting the score at 8-7 for the Lakers, who had already retreated in the game and managed to take the lead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 8:18 PM ET 2 hours ago Early lead for bucks
 Tyler Herro scored two points, followed by two free throws from Luka Doncic. Brayden Burries added two points, then two more, to open the game with a 7-2 lead for the Bucks at home, in a early lead in the game!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:16 PM ET 2 hours ago Here we go
 The players stepped onto the court and the ball flew for the Los Angeles Lakers vs. Milwaukee Bucks clash in the first quarter of the NBA regular season game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel right here on VAVEL! And, after the start, the Lakers have the first possession!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:05 PM ET 3 hours ago Starting five
 And here are the starting five for today's game! For the Los Angeles Lakers, the starting lineup is Matisse Thybulle, Jake LaRavia, Walker Kessler, Austin Reaves, and Luka Doncic. For the Milwaukee Bucks, the starting lineup is Bayden Burries, Tyler Herro, Nate Ament, Kyle Kuzma, and Kel'el Ware.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:55 PM ET 3 hours ago Today's games
 Two games today have already been completed: Kings 100-107 Magic and Trail Blazers 123-103 Thunder. We have three matches underway: Pacers 36-41 Wizards, Knicks 36-41 Cavaliers and Raptors 50-35 Celtics. Later today we will have: Grizzlies vs Nuggets, Pelicas vs Nets, Bulls vs Spurs, Jazz vs Magic and Rockets vs Warriors.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:52 PM ET 3 hours ago Yesterday's games
 Yesterday only six games took place, with the following match results: Warriors 138-87 Pelicans, Knicks 117-85 Bucjks, 76ers 101-123 Celtics, Jazz 109-115 Heat and Suns 133-110 Clippers, thus closing the Tuesday of games.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:44 PM ET 3 hours ago Monday's games
 On Monday (9), seven games took place, with the following results: Hawks 114-124 Lakers, Pistons 122 Wizards, Hornets 124-112 Cavaliers, Raptors 102-118 Grizzlies, Mavericks 125-122 Pacers, Rockets 110-100 Nuggets and Suns 96-122 Spurs.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:33 PM ET 3 hours ago Good evening!
 We begin our broadcast of the game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Milwaukee Bucks in this NBA regular season, taking place at the Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, on Monday night of the 2026-27 season!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:33 PM ET 3 hours ago Fiserv Forum: Today's game takes place at the Bucks' home arena!
 Today's game takes place at the Fiserv Forum, which was also called the Wisconsin Entertainment and Sports Center during its construction. Home to the Milwaukee Bucks, the arena also hosts games of the Marquette Golden Eagles of the NCAA. With a capacity of over 16,000 spectators, the arena opened in 2018.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:33 PM ET 3 hours ago Eastern Conference: Here's how the Bucks' conference standings are
 The Milwaukee Bucks are in last place in the Eastern Conference, with one win and nine losses, behind the Bulls (one win and eight losses), the Nets (two wins and eight losses), the Magic (two wins and seven losses), the Pacers (three wins and eight losses), the Hornets and Wizards (four wins and seven losses), the Heat (four wins and six losses), and the Cavaliers (five wins and six losses).
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:20 PM ET 3 hours ago Western Conference: Here's how the Lakers' competition standings are
 In the Western Conference, the Los Angeles Lakers lead with 10 wins and two losses, currently in sole possession of first place, ahead of the Spurs, with nine wins and two losses, the Thunder, with eight wins and two losses, the Warriors, Timberwolves and Rockets, with eight wins and three losses, the Grizzlies, with seven wins and three losses, and the Trail Blazers, with six wins and three losses.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:41 PM ET 4 hours ago How are the Milwaukee Bucks doing for today's game?
 The Milwaukee Bucks, for their part, are coming off five straight losses this season. On Monday (2), they lost 112-100 to the Timberwolves. On Wednesday (4), they lost 109-102 to the Bucks. On Friday (6), they lost 121-107 to the Raptors in the NBA Cup. On Sunday (8), they lost 117-97 to the Celtics. And yesterday, they lost 117-85 to the Knicks.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:04 PM ET 5 hours ago Injury Report: Who's out on the Bucks' side?
 On the other side, the Milwaukee Bucks will update their injury report again. Using the most recent one so far, for the game against the Knicks, Tyler Herro was sidelined with a knee injury, being the only player out of the game.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5:25 PM ET 5 hours ago Injury Report: Who's out for the Lakers?
 For today's game, the Los Angeles Lakers will be very fortunate, going in without any injuries, with only one player listed as questionable, and a chance of missing Quentin Grimes due to a finger injury, being the only possible absence.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
